Name: Cranberry Bog - Irrigable Cranberries
Author: aurrie
Description:
Cranberries and frogs, it must be fall 🐸

Does what it says on the tin. Very simple Content Patcher mod (setting IsPaddyCrop value to true) that lets Cranberries benefit from being planted near bodies of water just like Taro Roots and Rice! No need to water + have faster growing time. Probably a little overpowered, might consider an optional balance that nerfs sell price and/or increases growth speed to compensate.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with 1.6!
[*]Hasn't been tested on anything other than Windows.
[/list]
